pages.text: Prehistoric supplies and equipment change combat and eating strategies.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Heavy Bone makes the club and joins Tough Hide for armor. Salad clears stun, stew damage scales with missing health and armor pieces improve raw-meat recovery. These are distinct native uses, not a blanket food buff.
